text: The source that classifies the 2025 loss area as native forest is the Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) National forest cartography version 2021. According to this source, the event area of 13.5 ha consists of 13.1 ha of native forest and 0.4 ha outside mapped forest. The MGAP map distinguishes between native and planted forest, providing the territorial context for the change but not its cause.
